items.title: Skitch Henderson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Milford, Connecticut, October 31, 1998
items.q: He wanted to go back to Italy. So he gave me an orchestra. And he told me never to play French music, and to learn the Italian overtures

ctx.x: ‘50, 1950, ‘52, ‘51, ‘52. And that again was luck because Mr. Toscanini didn’t want to do summer concerts. He wanted to go back to Italy. So he gave me an orchestra. And he told me never to play French music, and to learn the Italian overtures, which I very carefully
did learn and that was of great value. And then I was there for of course the sad dismissal of the orchestra.
